reason: Provides agent-facing tools to browse and manage files on S3-compatible storage, Xiaomi FDS, and FTP/FTPS, including approval-gated mutations and cancellable transfers.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供浏览和管理 S3 兼容存储、小米 FDS 及 FTP/FTPS 文件的工具，并对修改操作进行逐次审批。
summaries.en: Provides agent tools for browsing and managing files on S3-compatible storage, Xiaomi FDS, and FTP/FTPS with per-operation approval for mutations.

capabilities: Creates, deletes, moves, and copies remote files
